author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0005615 extracellular space & replace by GO:0005576 extracellular region, see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31545. The reason for obsoletion is that the distinction between these two terms is not very useful in the ontology.


There are 5177 manual annotations (including extensions). For mostt groups these should be automatically replaced. 
Annotation review spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1h_e_BwvXw2QAFMGgnGObb7g_KPSwH_CasI_KVCx4jVE/edit?gid=0#gid=0

author: pgaudet
body:
Yes - cell wall-bounded periplasmic space is staying. Next step is for Marc and I to review the hierarchy, but it may be fine. 

 i

author: mlkaldunski
body:
RGD has electronically replaced GO:0005615 extracellular space with GO:0005576 extracellular region.
Should be sent to GO in the next GAF, or maybe the one after that if our system updates have to go through first.

author: sarach06
body:
Hi,
Thank you very much and apologies for the delay. I have replaced GO:0005615 with GO:0005576 in all the InterPro entries. These changes will be visible in the next InterPro release (109.0).

Best regards,
Sara
